Upgradeable BPF loader instruction handling, program deploy, execute, extend, upgrade, close, and migrate logic.

# Purpose
This file implements the BPF loader program logic for Firedancer. It handles program deployment, execution, upgrade, close, authority changes, extension, and migration for Solana BPF loader accounts. The code maps loader and VM errors to instruction errors, computes heap cost, loads and validates ELF program data, and prepares the VM state before execution. It also checks feature flags and account state so the behavior matches Solana loader rules for upgradeable programs and deprecated loaders.

The main entry points are [`fd_bpf_loader_program_execute`](<#fd_bpf_loader_program_execute>), which processes loader instructions or runs a loaded program, and [`fd_deploy_program`](<#fd_deploy_program>), which loads and validates program bytes into the runtime cache. Helper functions such as [`write_program_data`](<#write_program_data>), [`fd_bpf_loader_program_get_state`](<#fd_bpf_loader_program_get_state>), [`fd_bpf_loader_v3_program_set_state`](<#fd_bpf_loader_v3_program_set_state>), [`common_close_account`](<#common_close_account>), and [`common_extend_program`](<#common_extend_program>) manage account state and data updates. The file also exposes [`fd_directly_invoke_loader_v3_deploy`](<#fd_directly_invoke_loader_v3_deploy>), but that function is not implemented and stops with an error.
